items.title: SilkParasite Espionage Campaign Targets Central Asian Governments with Five New RATs
items.description: A previously unreported cyber espionage operation dubbed SilkParasite has been observed targeting government bodies in Central Asia. items.title: Phishing 3.0: The Fight Moves to Agent Versus Agent
items.description: Most email defenses still do the job they did a decade ago. Scan the message, look for something malicious, block it. That worked when the danger sat in the payload, a bad link or an attachment. It stopped working when the danger moved into the message's intent, and it is failing now that the sender is no longer a person.
